LESSON: KUANDIKA 8.3.1 VIAKIFISHI KIFUPI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua matumizi ya mabano na kistari kifupi katika matini
2. kutumia mabano na kistari kifupi ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua matumizi ya mabano na kistari kifupi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua matumizi ya mabano na kistari kifupi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia mabano na kistari kifupi ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia mabano na kistari kifupi ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua matumizi ya mabano na kistari kifupi katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi kifupi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua matumizi ya mabano na kistari kifupi katika matini
2. kutumia mabano na kistari kifupi ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
